# LeadStack

> LeadStack is a B2B leads marketplace. Approved buyers browse exclusive leads matched to their business by AI, then buy them at clear, upfront prices. Once bought, a lead is exclusive to that buyer for 2 months and is never resold.

LeadStack sources leads from real sales work: companies that are a strong fit for our own sales team but no longer an active priority are released to marketplace buyers, matched by AI to the buyer's business.

## Key facts

- Buyers see company, industry, location, need, and notes before paying; phone and email unlock after purchase.
- Pricing is quantity-based with volume discounts, shown as a total before checkout. No subscription, no hidden fees.
- Payment is by UPI or card through Razorpay; LeadStack never stores card details.
- Access is by request only; every request is reviewed manually before login credentials are issued.
- Used by buyers in 120+ countries, including the US and UK.
